note: QA-B336 engine held-out set, round 7 (Fable run, COO 23:25Z 14 Nov). Written before any round-7 code and before reading QA's 2207Z and 2305Z sets. The class is a wish, plan or intent that a person's body be harmed, by ANY means, in three forms (first person, reported of someone, received as a threat), plus the same for oneself. Positives name means and intent forms the floor's lists never held (electricity, gas, allergen, insulin, inhaler, brakes, climbing rope, antifreeze, heat in a car, bees, a wire across a trail, infection, an overpass, 'won't wake up', 'have an accident', 'disappear', 'never walk again', 'sleep with one eye open'), some with no cue word and no harm verb at all. Benign controls hold the same words in prevention, reporting of news or history, negation and counterfactuals, idiom and hyperbole, fiction and games, emotional hurt, medical and care, sport and cooking. Fictional sentences only. Never tuned on. Scored with keywordRisk (floor) and with the semantic check; both counts recorded in the test.
